en: A vintage postcard image depicting an old European street lined with tall trees and row houses. There are people walking and cycling, dressed in early 20th-century or late 19th-century attire, suggesting a historical period. The style of buildings and fashion indicates a city in Western Europe. The caption at the bottom reads 'Nijmegen' on the left and 'Bottendaal' on the right.
